[CheckReturnValue] The result of `evaluate()` must be used
  If you really don't want to use the result, then assign it to a variable: `var unused = ...`.
  
  If callers of `evaluate()` shouldn't be required to use its result, then annotate it with `@CanIgnoreReturnValue`.
  
    (see https://errorprone.info/bugpattern/CheckReturnValue)
  Did you mean 'var unused = expr.evaluate();' or to remove this line?

[FutureReturnValueIgnored] Return value of methods returning Future must be checked. Ignoring returned Futures suppresses exceptions thrown from the code that completes the Future.
    (see https://errorprone.info/bugpattern/FutureReturnValueIgnored)
  Did you mean 'var unused = future.thenAccept(result -> variables.put(variable, result));' or to remove this line?

[NullAway] initializer method does not guarantee @NonNull field 'expressionParser' (line 18) is initialized along all control-flow paths (remember to check for exceptions or early returns).
    (see http://t.uber.com/nullaway )

[JdkObsolete] Stack is a nonstandard class that predates the Java Collections Framework; prefer ArrayDeque. Note that the Stack methods push/pop/peek correspond to the Deque methods addFirst/removeFirst/peekFirst.
    (see https://errorprone.info/bugpattern/JdkObsolete)
